picks.title: Is Nvidia the new Cisco? NVDA since ChatGPT vs CSCO in the dot-com era (start = 100)
picks.description: Nvidia since the ChatGPT launch vs Cisco from the Netscape IPO, both rebased to 100 on a log scale, by trading days since start.
picks.reason: Nvidia's board is weighing Jensen Huang's future and NVDA sold off; the dot-com Cisco path is the obvious comparison.

picks.title: "Musk Inc." (Tesla + SpaceX) vs Nvidia, Apple and Microsoft: market value since the SpaceX IPO
picks.description: Combined market value of Tesla plus SpaceX against Nvidia, Apple and Microsoft since the SpaceX IPO, in trillions of dollars.
picks.reason: Musk publicly floated hiring Huang as Nvidia's value slid, putting Musk Inc. and Nvidia side by side in the news.

picks.title: US Spot Bitcoin ETF Daily Net Flows ($ millions)
picks.description: Daily net flows into US spot bitcoin ETFs in millions of dollars, inflows in green and outflows in red, since June 2025.
picks.reason: Spot bitcoin ETFs are back to outflows while bitcoin trades near a large liquidation cluster.

picks.title: Strategy's leverage, Jan 2025–Oct 2026: debt + preferreds = 30% of its bitcoin (peak 43.5%)
picks.description: Strategy's debt plus preferred stock as a percent of the value of its bitcoin, split into preferreds and convertible notes, Jan 2025 to Oct 2026.
picks.reason: With bitcoin under pressure and MSCI index outflow scenarios in focus, Strategy's leverage ratio is the number to watch.

picks.title: What the bond market expects from the Fed: 2-year Treasury yield minus the effective fed funds rate (month-end)
picks.description: The 2-year Treasury yield minus the effective fed funds rate at month-end, a gauge of where the bond market expects policy to go.
picks.reason: After the hot CPI report the market is pricing a December hike and the dollar is at a 19-month high.
